{text:body}

Springfield has been built almost entirely since the 1990s, and most homes in Springfield Lakes, Augustine Heights and Brookwater went up after 2000. Even a young roof can leak. The problems we see most are builder defects that only show once the warranty has run out: flashings badly fitted around skylights and solar panels, valleys that were never sealed properly, and gutters too small for a heavy summer storm. Two-storey homes sit close together on many of the estates, so we bring the right access gear and let your neighbours know before we start. Camira is the older end of the area, with plenty of 1970s and 80s brick homes whose tile roofs are now due for restoration. Spring Mountain and the newer estates around it are mostly Colorbond, where we repair storm damage and replace screws that have worked loose. If the problem is small, we fix it and keep the quote small too.
